limits: Readable sample values are not Photoshop equivalents, universal Cos parameters or natural-shaping defaults.
Creative flower generation is not evidence of reconstructing genuine anatomy hidden by a box or other obstruction.
Candidate previews and application buttons do not verify final application, export, identity preservation or original-photo detail quality.
Different flower distributions across sequence-07 and sequence-08 prevent treating them as a controlled relighting comparison.
The final dark image lacks a before/original label; its role is not inferred from the filename or appearance.
Root playback end-state and isolated screenshot review do not establish an independently verified continuous watch interval.
